scope: static, AI-assisted, nothing executed; production diff read line by line, tests skimmed; tripwire, overlap and apply-vs-main triage used; the diff only shows lock acquisition lines without surrounding code, so lock nesting was not fully verifiable
findings: file_system.cpp: adds 64 striped mutexes keyed by a hash of the upper-cased folder path so RemoveDirectoryW and a create inside the folder are ordered like the host. 38 prod lines plus a 2000-round race test and doc lines.

Hardening note: with striped locks, two different folders can share a mutex; if any path locks the parent folder and then the folder itself (or a second folder) in the same thread, a std::mutex would self-deadlock. The diff does not show such nesting; maintainers should confirm. Applies cleanly, no overlaps.
